THE RULE SYSTEM (plain words):
World: individuals at continuous positions in a square periodic domain, starting with 4,000 placed at random. Rules (continuous-time birth and death): (1) each individual gives birth at rate 1920; the offspring lands at a Gaussian offset (standard deviation 0.05); (2) each individual dies at rate 192 + (density of others within radius 1.25) + g times (density within radius 0.0625, squared: a three-body crowding term). Densities are counts divided by disk area. Only competitive (harmful) interactions, no attraction or help. Set g = 3.14e-5 and run for 1 time unit; look at the steady spatial pattern.
